title_o: Self-Controlled Feedback: Does It Enhance Learning Because Performers Get Feedback When They Need It?

replications.quote: No group differences during the post-tests for mean radial error, F(2, 54) = 2.71, p = .075, or bivariate variable error, F(2, 56) = 0.11, p = .896, were found. Thus, the typical self-controlled learning advantage was not observed.
